message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to incoming data; files are read and used directly without any validation.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read from local filesystem paths only; there is no remote fetching, and no integrity checks (checksums, signatures, pinned revisions) are present anywhere in the code.
No detected label flipping detection: The code reads labels from CSV and uses them directly without any validation against an expected set, distribution comparison, or label-noise detection tool.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The pipeline applies only StandardScaler normalization with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.
No detected model integrity verification: Models are saved and loaded via pickle (joblib) and Keras without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision verification before use.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label set, or anomalous sample distribution before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation analysis, trigger detection, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library or mechanism (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or any robustness stress testing anywhere in the evaluation path.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although a train/test split is performed, the test set is derived from the same load_feature call as the training data with no isolation guarantees, no hashing/signing of evaluation data, and only a single accuracy metric is reported with no independent verification.

No detected input sanitization: No input shape/range checks, schema validation, or malformed-input rejection are present on the inference data-flow path; features are passed directly to the model after scaling.
No detected output bounds checks: Model predictions are returned directly (via predict() or argmax) with no NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an audio emotion recognition pipeline using SVM/MLP/LSTM models, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
